name: Raised Crosswalk Locations
description:
This dataset records locations of raised crosswalks, likely as part of a transportation safety or traffic-calming program. Each of the 159 sampled rows includes a treatment type (mostly "Raised Crosswalk," with a small number of variants such as leg-specific or mid-block crosswalks), a date, a node identifier, and point geometry given as both WKT and x/y coordinates. The coordinates appear to be in a projected local system rather than latitude and longitude. A few records have missing node IDs or geometry values.

The data can be used to map and inventory raised crosswalks, examine where and when they were installed, compare treatment types across locations, and support pedestrian safety studies, planning, or GIS analysis of street infrastructure.
